title: Hill Climber sudoku
author: Banango
rules:
Normal Sudoku Rules apply.

Connect the similar colours with orthogonally moving lines such that the digits along the line increase then decrease.

The lines may not intersect and a line will not visit 2 adjacent cells in the grid unless they are adjacent on the route.

The digits on the line must both increase and decrease so the series of numbers: 1458765, and 67532 are allowed but 134678 and 97532 are not.

Any advice on how to make puzzles on sudukupad would be appreciated. I don't think I used a correct approach.

I also couldn't get the link to work with HTML.

https://sudokupad.app/scf?
solutionCode: The second row read left to right.
